help_command.title: 🕵️‍♂️ *SherLog Manual*
help_command.intro: Welcome, fellow developer! My mission is to ensure a clean environment for code and discussion. Here are your tools to interact with me:
help_command.reporting_body:
Encountered an annoying or rule-breaking message? Don't argue, just follow these steps:
• *Reply* to the offending message.
• Type the command: /report
• I will immediately forward a copy to the admins for action.
help_command.code_style_body:
We are programmers, and our code should be elegant! Sending long plain text code is forbidden.
Use *triple backticks* to format your code like this:
help_command.link_safety_body:
To protect you, only links from globally trusted sources are allowed, such as:
• `GitHub, GitLab`
• `StackOverflow`
• `pub.dev, dart.dev`
Any suspicious external link will be detected and you will be alerted.

auto_replies.flutter_installation_guide_body: • Download the zip file from [the official website here](https://docs.flutter.dev/get-started/install/windows/mobile).

• Unzip it in a separate folder like
: `C:/src/flutter`.
⚠️ *Note:* Do not unzip in `Program Files` to avoid permission issues.
• Go to the `flutter/bin` folder and copy the path from the address bar.
• Search for `Edit the system environment variables` in Windows.
• Find `Path` in both lists (User & System variables).
• Open the program -> Go to `Plugins` -> Search for `Flutter` and install it.
• Go to `SDK Manager` -> `SDK Tools` and enable these options:
• On your phone: Settings -> Developer options.
• Connect the cable and accept the confirmation message on your phone's screen.
• 💡 *Note:* Use a `VPN` for the first run only to download libraries.
• Congratulations! You are now ready to go. 🎉

welcome.new_member_message:
Welcome {user_mention} to our community 💙

Welcome to *{community_name}*. As the automated assistant *SherLog* 🕵️‍♂️, I am pleased to accompany you to organize the workflow and discussions.

To ensure a professional learning environment, please adhere to the following guidelines:

🔹 *1. Dialogue Etiquette:* Stick to constructive technical discussions, and avoid side topics or inappropriate behavior.
🔹 *2. Information Security:* It is forbidden to post untrusted links or promotional content (Spam) to maintain the safety of members.
🔹 *3. Content Quality:* When asking programming questions, please use code blocks to ensure clarity.

We wish you a useful and fruitful experience. 🚀
